'''Trandoshan Elites''' were a [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] group that worked closely with Trandoshan [[Slavery/Legends|slavers]].

In battle, Trandoshan Elites typically carried [[LS-150 Heavy Accelerated Charged Particle Repeater Gun]]s, with a bayonet, which could pierce even [[Clone trooper armor/Legends|clone trooper armor]]. They also wore a set of extremely durable [[Armor/Legends|armor]].

The clone commando unit [[Delta Squad/Legends|Delta Squad]] encountered several of them on various missions such as the ''[[Prosecutor]]'' infiltration. They also participated in the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|CIS]] attempt to take [[Kachirho/Legends|Kachirho]] and claim [[Battle of Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]].
